        w = (im.min(2) > 180) & (xx > 75) & (xx < 135) & (yy > 60) & (yy < 105)
        lab, n = label(w)
        k = max(range(1, n + 1), key=lambda k: np.sum(lab == k))
        y, x = np.where(lab == k)
        whites.append((x.mean(), y.mean() + .25))
        if t < 13:
            blacks.append((127.65, 69.45))
        else:
            b = (im.max(2) < 90) & (xx > 125) & (xx < 179) & (yy > 43) & (yy < 73)
            lab, n = label(b)
            sizes = [(np.sum(lab == k), k) for k in range(1, n + 1)]
            if sizes:
                _, k = max(sizes)
                y, x = np.where(lab == k)
                blacks.append((x.mean(), y.mean() - 1.05))
            else:
                blacks.append(blacks[-1])
    return np.array(whites), np.array(blacks)

    whites, blacks = source_centers(src)
    bg, corridor = clean_background(src, whites, blacks)
    cap = cv2.VideoCapture(str(ROOT/'source_video.mp4'))
    ok, first_hi = cap.read()
    cap.release()
    if not ok:
        raise RuntimeError('Cannot decode source frame')
    first_hi = cv2.cvtColor(first_hi, cv2.COLOR_BGR2RGB)
    assets = {kind: extract_residual(first_hi,kind) for kind in ['white','black']}

    # Plane homography from four straight inner cushion edges. The table has
    # aspect 2:1; these coordinates also account for the source perspective.
    world = np.float32([[0,0],[1,0],[1,2],[0,2]])
    image = np.float32([[-14.8,104.74],[99.2,152.48],[207.,50.5],[139.,39.5]])
    H = cv2.getPerspectiveTransform(world,image)
    def project(x,z):
        p = H@np.array([x,z,1.])
        return p[:2]/p[2]
    inv = np.linalg.inv(H)
    def unproject(x,y):
        p = inv@np.array([x,y,1.])
        return p[:2]/p[2]
    # Source-aligned centre line and source-fitted incoming speed/cloth drag.
    xline = .487
    white0 = unproject(85.4,93.95)[1]
    target0 = unproject(127.6,69.4)[1]
    v0, incoming_drag = .953, .146
    radius = .0355
    separation = 2*radius
    contact_z = target0-separation
    tc = (v0-np.sqrt(v0*v0-2*incoming_drag*(contact_z-white0)))/incoming_drag
    incoming = v0-incoming_drag*tc
    restitution = .77
    mass_cue, mass_target = 1., 10.
    cue_velocity = (mass_cue-restitution*mass_target)/(mass_cue+mass_target)*incoming
    target_velocity = (1+restitution)*mass_cue/(mass_cue+mass_target)*incoming
    cue_drag, target_drag = .100, .073
    cushion = radius+.008
    speed = -cue_velocity
    distance = contact_z-cushion
    discriminant = speed*speed-2*cue_drag*distance
    hit_dt = (speed-np.sqrt(discriminant))/cue_drag if discriminant>0 else np.inf
    hit_speed = max(0., speed-cue_drag*hit_dt) if np.isfinite(hit_dt) else 0.
    bounce_speed = .76*hit_speed

    out = np.empty_like(src)
    trace = []
    for i in range(N):
        t = i/24.
        if t < tc:
            # Increasing inertial mass alone has no visible pre-contact effect.
            out[i] = src[i]
            trace.append((t, float(whites[i,0]), float(whites[i,1]),127.6,69.4))
            continue

        bt = min(dt,target_velocity/target_drag)
        target_z = target0 + target_velocity*bt-.5*target_drag*bt*bt
        if dt <= hit_dt:
            ct = min(dt,speed/cue_drag)
            cue_z = contact_z-speed*ct+.5*cue_drag*ct*ct
        else:
            ct = min(dt-hit_dt,bounce_speed/cue_drag)
            cue_z = cushion+bounce_speed*ct-.5*cue_drag*ct*ct

        # Depth denominator at the measured sprite's original location.
        for kind, pos, z, zref in [
            ('white',cue_pos,cue_z,white0),
            ('black',target_pos,target_z,target0)]:

            frame += render_residual(residual,origin,pos,ratio)

        trace.append((t,*cue_pos,*target_pos))

                             cv2.VideoWriter_fourcc(*'mp4v'),24,(WW,HH))
    if not writer.isOpened():
        raise RuntimeError('Cannot open video encoder')

        writer.write(cv2.cvtColor(frame,cv2.COLOR_RGB2BGR))
    writer.release()
    np.savetxt(ROOT/'motion_trace.txt',trace,fmt='%.5f',header='time cue_x cue_y target_x target_y')
    print('Saved',out.shape,out.dtype)
    print('Mass ratio 10:1; contact %.4fs, velocities %.4f / %.4f; cushion %.4fs' %
          (tc,cue_velocity,target_velocity,tc+hit_dt))
    print('Final image centers:',trace[-1][1:])

def save(frames, case_dir, audio=None):
    case_dir = Path(case_dir)
    frames = np.asarray(frames)
    path = case_dir / "task_spec.json"
    spec = json.loads(path.read_text()) if path.is_file() else {}
    n, h, w, fps = (spec.get("frames", 20), spec.get("height", 144), spec.get("width", 256), spec.get("fps", 4))
    assert frames.shape == (n, h, w, 3) and frames.dtype == np.uint8, frames.shape
    audio_spec = spec.get("audio")
    audio_url = None
    if audio_spec:
        samples = round(n / fps * audio_spec["sample_rate"])
        pcm = np.asarray(audio)
        if pcm.ndim == 1:
            pcm = pcm[:, None]
        assert pcm.shape == (samples, audio_spec["channels"]) and pcm.dtype == np.int16, (pcm.shape, pcm.dtype)
        with wave.open(str(case_dir / "audio.wav"), "wb") as handle:
            handle.setnchannels(audio_spec["channels"])
            handle.setsampwidth(2)
            handle.setframerate(audio_spec["sample_rate"])
            handle.writeframes(pcm.astype("<i2").tobytes())
        audio_url = "data:audio/wav;base64," + base64.b64encode((case_dir / "audio.wav").read_bytes()).decode()
    values = frames.astype(np.uint32)
    packed = (values[:, :, :, 0] << 16) | (values[:, :, :, 1] << 8) | values[:, :, :, 2]
    tensor = packed.transpose(1, 2, 0)
    np.savez_compressed(case_dir / "pixels.npz", pixels=tensor)

    folder = case_dir / "frames"
    folder.mkdir(exist_ok=True)
    for index, frame in enumerate(frames):
        Image.fromarray(frame).save(folder / f"{index:02d}.png")

    sheet = Image.new("RGB", (w * 4, (h + 21) * 2), (25, 28, 35))
    draw = ImageDraw.Draw(sheet)
    for index, frame_index in enumerate(np.linspace(0, n - 1, 8).round().astype(int)):
        x, y = (index % 4) * w, (index // 4) * (h + 21)
        draw.text((x + 5, y + 3), f"frame {frame_index:02d} · {frame_index / fps:.2f}s", fill="white")
        sheet.paste(Image.fromarray(frames[frame_index]), (x, y + 21))
    sheet.save(case_dir / "inspection.png")

    transition = Image.new("RGB", (w * 4, h * 2 + 21), (25, 28, 35))
    draw = ImageDraw.Draw(transition)
    for index, frame_index in enumerate(min(i, n-1) for i in range(4)):
        x = index * w
        draw.text((x + 5, 4), f"frame {frame_index:02d} · {frame_index / fps:.2f}s", fill="white")
        transition.paste(Image.fromarray(frames[frame_index]), (x, 21))
        transition.paste(Image.fromarray(frames[frame_index]).resize((w, h), Image.Resampling.NEAREST), (x, h + 21))
    transition.save(case_dir / "transition_check.png")

    encode = lambda array: base64.b64encode(np.asarray(array, dtype="<u4").tobytes()).decode()
    deltas = []
    for index in range(1, n):
        current = packed[index].reshape(-1)
        previous = packed[index - 1].reshape(-1)
        positions = np.flatnonzero(current != previous)
        packet = []
        if len(positions):
            bounds = np.r_[0, np.flatnonzero(np.diff(positions) > 1) + 1, len(positions)]
            for start, end in zip(bounds[:-1], bounds[1:]):
                offset = int(positions[start])
                count = int(end - start)
                packet.extend([offset, count])
                packet.extend(current[offset:offset + count].tolist())
        deltas.append(encode(packet))
    data = {
        "id": case_dir.name,
        "width": w, "height": h, "frames": n, "fps": fps, "audio": audio_url,
        "first": encode(packed[0].reshape(-1)),
        "deltas": deltas,
        "caption": (case_dir / "prompt.txt").read_text().strip(),
    }
    template = (Path(__file__).parent / "player_template.html").read_text()
    payload = json.dumps(data, separators=(",", ":"), ensure_ascii=False).replace("<", "\\u003c")
    (case_dir / "index.html").write_text(template.replace("__ID__", case_dir.name).replace("__DATA__", payload))

from pathlib import Path
import numpy as np
import cv2
from scipy.ndimage import label, binary_dilation
from artifact_io import save

ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parent
N, HH, WW = 96, 144, 256


def source_centers(src):
    \"\"\"Numerical colour/connected-component measurements, no visual tools.\"\"\"
    yy, xx = np.mgrid[:HH, :WW]
    whites = []
    blacks = []
    for t, im in enumerate(src.astype(float)):
        w = (im.min(2) > 180) & (xx > 75) & (xx < 135) & (yy > 60) & (yy < 105)
        lab, n = label(w)
        k = max(range(1, n + 1), key=lambda k: np.sum(lab == k))
        y, x = np.where(lab == k)
        whites.append((x.mean(), y.mean() + .25))
        if t < 13:
            blacks.append((127.65, 69.45))
        else:
            b = (im.max(2) < 90) & (xx > 125) & (xx < 179) & (yy > 43) & (yy < 73)
            lab, n = label(b)
            sizes = [(np.sum(lab == k), k) for k in range(1, n + 1)]
            if sizes:
                _, k = max(sizes)
                y, x = np.where(lab == k)
                blacks.append((x.mean(), y.mean() - 1.05))
            else:
                blacks.append(blacks[-1])
    return np.array(whites), np.array(blacks)


def poly_features(x, y):
    return np.stack([x*0+1, x, y, x*x, x*y, y*y], -1)


def clean_background(src, whites, blacks):
    bg = np.median(src.astype(float), axis=0)
    # The cue ball occupies this small area for most of the factual video.
    # Reconstruct only its footprint using the surrounding untouched cloth.
    y, x = np.mgrid[61:83, 115:137]
    features = poly_features((x-126)/12, (y-72)/12)
    clear = ~(((x-125.5)/7.4)**2 + ((y-71.5)/9.0)**2 < 1)
    coeff = np.linalg.lstsq(features[clear], bg[y[clear], x[clear]], rcond=None)[0]
    fitted = features @ coeff
    dirty = (((x-125.5)/6.9)**2 + ((y-71.5)/7.9)**2 < 1)
    bg[y[dirty], x[dirty]] = fitted[dirty]
    # Restrict replacements to the factual ball and contact-shadow corridor.
    yy, xx = np.mgrid[:HH, :WW]
    corridor = np.zeros((HH, WW), bool)
    for kind, poses in [('white', whites), ('black', blacks)]:
        for cx, cy in poses:
            depthscale = np.clip((283.9-cx)/(283.9-85.5), .52, 1.1)
            rx = (7.8 if kind == 'white' else 7.2)*depthscale
            ry = (8.8 if kind == 'white' else 8.2)*depthscale
            corridor |= ((xx-cx)/rx)**2 + ((yy-(cy+1.65*depthscale))/ry)**2 < 1
    corridor = binary_dilation(corridor, iterations=1)
    return bg, corridor


def extract_residual(first_hi, kind):
    # Actual source material, highlight and contact-shadow are retained.
    if kind == 'white':
        bounds = (390, 466, 435, 516)
        center = (429., 472.)
        sx, sy = 41., 43.
    else:
        bounds = (605, 676, 314, 390)
        center = (640., 349.)
        sx, sy = 38., 39.
    x0, x1, y0, y1 = bounds
    patch = first_hi[y0:y1, x0:x1].astype(float)
    y, x = np.mgrid[y0:y1, x0:x1]
    u, v = (x-center[0])/sx, (y-center[1])/sy
    basis = poly_features(u, v)
    # Fit unoccluded green pixels near the outside of the source crop.
    ring = (u*u+v*v > .88) & (patch[:,:,1] > patch[:,:,0]+36) & (patch[:,:,1] > 150)
    coeff = np.linalg.lstsq(basis[ring], patch[ring], rcond=None)[0]
    base = basis @ coeff
    residual = patch-base
    fade = np.clip((1.11 - np.sqrt(u*u+v*v))/.22, 0, 1)
    residual *= fade[...,None]
    # Codec variation in the surrounding unoccluded cloth is not material.
    residual[np.max(np.abs(residual),axis=2)<2.3] = 0
    return residual.astype(np.float32), (center[0]-x0, center[1]-y0)


def render_residual(residual, origin, pos, scale, supersample=3):
    cx, cy = pos
    f = scale*supersample/5
    M = np.array([[f, 0, (cx+.5)*supersample-.5-f*origin[0]],

    layer = cv2.warpAffine(residual,M,(WW*supersample,HH*supersample),
                           flags=cv2.INTER_LINEAR,borderMode=cv2.BORDER_CONSTANT)
    return cv2.resize(layer,(WW,HH),interpolation=cv2.INTER_AREA)


def generate():
    src = np.load(ROOT/'source_pixels.npz')['rgb']
    whites, blacks = source_centers(src)
    bg, corridor = clean_background(src, whites, blacks)
    cap = cv2.VideoCapture(str(ROOT/'source_video.mp4'))
    ok, first_hi = cap.read()

    # aspect 2:1; these coordinates also account for the source perspective.

        p = H@np.array([x,z,1.])

    inv = np.linalg.inv(H)
    def unproject(x,y):
        p = inv@np.array([x,y,1.])
        return p[:2]/p[2]
    # Source-aligned centre line and source-fitted incoming speed/cloth drag.
    xline = .487
    white0 = unproject(85.4,93.95)[1]
    target0 = unproject(127.6,69.4)[1]

    restitution = .77

    cue_velocity = (mass_cue-restitution*mass_target)/(mass_cue+mass_target)*incoming
    target_velocity = (1+restitution)*mass_cue/(mass_cue+mass_target)*incoming

    distance = contact_z-cushion
